context: Asuka lectures on examples in argument.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: lecture; connectives (たとえば/それら/本来/もっとも/そもそも) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 主張には、たとえばの例が役立ちます。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: それらの例は、どう選ぶんですか?
lines.en: How do we choose those examples?
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: それらは、本来の主張に沿って選びます。
lines.en: We choose those in line with the original claim.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: そもそも、例はいくつ要りますか?
lines.en: To begin with, how many examples are needed?
lines.style: curious adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: もっとも、多すぎても伝わりません。
lines.en: That said, too many won't get through.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: たとえば、二つか三つでしょうか?
lines.style: thoughtful adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そもそも、質が本来は大切なんです。
lines.en: Fundamentally, quality is what truly matters.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: それらを、丁寧に選びます。
lines.style: satisfied adult student voice, soft warm appreciative throughout
